The report covers the right historical period but pools paying users across corporate and consumer products. It does not isolate ChatGPT economics. The positive margin therefore cannot establish that ChatGPT subscribers were profitable. The unnamed-source figure was not confirmed by OpenAI.

contract.note: Frequent failures and a need for supervision are an ordinary reading of the firm launch-readiness criticism. This interpretation supplies the test for otherwise imprecise wording. The market opinion is appropriately excluded.

evidence.note: OpenAI's launch disclosure acknowledges uneven reliability and research-preview status. It supports the readiness criticism, though it is a company assessment.
OpenAI reports 38.1% success on computer-control tasks for the underlying CUA model. This supports capability limitations, with the caveat that it is not a direct trial of Operator's browser product.
The contemporary roundup reports mistakes requiring constant supervision for important tasks. Its evidence consists of individual user reports, not a representative study.
Strong results on simpler web tasks qualify the broadest criticism. These company benchmarks show useful capability, while the lower complex-task results remain consistent with uneven reliability.

reviews.rationale: Under the contract's fair reading, launch disclosures and contemporary user reports support inconsistent performance and a need for supervision. Strong simple-task results limit the broadest wording but do not establish general-use reliability. The market opinion and hedged clause are not separately scored.
